notablePrerequisites: An opponent has at least eight cards in their graveyard.
description:
Cast Leveler by paying {5}.
When Leveler enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling your library.
Activate Merfolk Windrobber by sacrificing it, causing you to return Merfolk Windrobber from your graveyard to the battlefield due to Out of the Tombs.
Repeat step 3.
